### AI agents that don't just read data. They act on it.

Prebuilt connectors, open APIs, and event triggers mean agents do not just read data. They take action across the systems that run the business.

Plug-and-play integration fabric

Hundreds of ready-to-use connectors and filters. Secure, scalable, and optimized for real-time data orchestration. Compatible with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday, Power BI, telephony and more.

Pull live data for accurate answers, then push updates, tickets, tasks, and approvals back into core systems.

Event-driven orchestration

## Frequently asked questions

Get answers to the most common questions about Druid's AI agents and the platform's integration layer before your demo.

What protocols and connector types does the integration fabric support?

REST, SOAP, GraphQL, WebSocket, database connectors (JDBC/ODBC), RPA bridges (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism), event-driven webhooks, and Model Context Protocol. All traffic routes through a unified security layer with TLS encryption, authentication, and full request/response logging.

What is event-driven orchestration and what triggers are supported?

Conductor subscribes to system events like SLA breaches, form submissions, ticket escalations, scheduled jobs, and custom webhooks and auto-dispatches agents to respond, route, and resolve without human initiation. Events are processed asynchronously with configurable retry policies and queues for failed deliveries.

How does the Graph RAG knowledge ingestion pipeline work?

Druid ingests PDFs, Office documents, web pages, images, videos, emails, SharePoint folders, tickets, and custom data via scheduled or event-triggered extractors. Content is chunked, embedded using proprietary vector models, and indexed in a hybrid store combining vector search and knowledge graph traversal for grounded, source-cited retrieval.

How does Druid handle enterprise systems without APIs?

For legacy or proprietary systems, Druid supports RPA bridges (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft), database connectors, screen-scraping adapters, and file-based integrations. These are orchestrated through the same Conductor pipeline as API-native connectors, with full logging and error handling.

What is the natural language query capability for BI systems?

Users query Power BI, Tableau, BigQuery, and other BI systems directly through conversation with no SQL and no dashboard training required. The agent translates natural language into structured queries, retrieves results, and presents them inline, supporting follow-up drill-downs within the same dialog.

How does the omnichannel runtime ensure consistent agent behavior?

A single agent definition with its flows, knowledge, orchestration rules, and governance policies deploys identically across voice (SIP/CCaaS), web chat, mobile, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, SMS, email, and custom interfaces. Channel adapters normalize input/output formats while Conductor maintains a unified conversation and execution context.
